title: Living-Infrastructure evidence consolidation and provenance
reason: OTA owns evidence for the Living Infrastructure program. The originating task records that repository-wide searches on 2026-09-25 did not find older Mars-fungi material under obvious terms and explicitly warns against treating that as absence: prior research may be external, differently named or not yet migrated. Without a consolidated evidence base, the integration layer risks duplicating or forgetting prior work and making an unfounded absence claim.
requested_change: Consolidate the living-infrastructure evidence base in OTA for mycology/soil ecology, closed-loop life support, agriculture, waste/recycling, Planetary Evolution coupling and ecopoiesis. Search OTA's own archive and known external or Drive holdings under alternate terms, including Mars/Pilze/fungi/mycelium/regolith/ecopoiesis and the existing entry points linked from thomaspeterkueper/kueper-ecosystem:reviews/2027-10-10-myzelbaustoffe-naturverbundenes-bauen.md (ENG docs/research/MYCO-0001-pilzbasierte-baustoffe-materialkreislaeufe.md and the NXU mycelium worldbuilding document). Record for each component what was located, what remains unlocated, and its maturity, provenance and uncertainty. Link the result to the program registration at thomaspeterkueper/kueper-ecosystem:docs/programs/living-infrastructure.md and do not canonize unverified claims.
expected_result: OTA publishes a provenance-backed living-infrastructure evidence profile/index stating which prior research is located, which remains unlocated, and what maturity and uncertainty each component has, providing the program with an auditable evidence anchor and no unfounded absence claim.
